examples.text: "Vich Ian Vohr," it said, in a voice that made my very blood curdle, "beware of to-morrow!"

glosses: 导致液体变质并凝结。

examples.text: It is enough,' said the agitated Mr. Slurk, pacing to and fro, 'to curdle the ink in one's pen, and induce one to abandon their cause for ever.'
